notes: Current Clos de Vougeot / Clos Vougeot specification homologated 25 March 2026. This supersedes and abrogates the 2011 decree. The existing machine schema encodes the core origin, composition, yield and analytical rules; calendar-specific elevage and release dates plus must-sugar and total-alcohol limits are recorded in source notes for promotion into the extended constraint layer in this tranche.

clos_vougeot_masaa_2026.authority: Ministère de l'agriculture, de l'agro-alimentaire et de la souveraineté alimentaire
clos_vougeot_masaa_2026.title: Cahier des charges de l'appellation d'origine contrôlée Clos de Vougeot ou Clos Vougeot
clos_vougeot_masaa_2026.scope: Current specification homologated by arrêté of 25 March 2026 and published 28 March 2026: red still wine; Pinot Noir principal with accessory varieties only in mixed plantings; 198 g/L minimum must sugar; 11.5% minimum natural alcohol; 42 hL/ha yield; 49 hL/ha maximum yield; <=0.4 g/L malic acid; <=2 g/L fermentable sugar; <=14.5% total alcohol after enrichment; elevage through 15 June; consumer release from 30 June of the following year.

clos_vougeot_legifrance_2026.authority: Journal officiel de la République française / Légifrance
clos_vougeot_legifrance_2026.title: Arrêté du 25 mars 2026 homologuant le cahier des charges de l'AOC Clos de Vougeot ou Clos Vougeot
clos_vougeot_legifrance_2026.scope: Homologates the 2026 specification and abrogates decree no. 2011-1332.

specs.notes: Current 2026 law. Conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path: Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are accessories only in mixed vineyard plantings, limited to 15% per parcel. The source also requires >=198 g/L must sugar, caps total alcohol after enrichment at 14.5%, requires elevage through 15 June, and permits consumer release from 30 June of the following year; these calendar/maturity fields are promoted by the extended legal constraint layer.
